name: my-marketplace
description: Local marketplace — personal overlay on the AIDD framework

plugins.name: overcode
plugins.description: Extends the AIDD framework with project-agnostic workflows: memory maintenance (harvest, reconcile-normative), obsolescence detection (taste), prospective analysis (foresee), behavioural-test harness for prompts (behave), test-suite governance by density and declared phase (control, user-invoked only), performance audits (data-optimize, web-optimize, ap-optimize), SEO/GEO audits (seo-optimize), project health reporting (status), plain-language explanations (baby), documentation (readme, changelog), and planning utilities (decompose, journey). Stack knowledge is never hardcoded: audits load pivots dropped by the sc-* plugins under .claude/rules/07-quality/. Alias chains: rechallenge, endtask, bump-plugin, previously, smarten, skillconf, weeklyemail, gitit, mirror, codex-vision.

plugins.name: design
plugins.description: Builds, critiques, freezes, enforces, and diffuses design systems from briefs, visual references, or existing code through standalone skills or an optional end-to-end workflow.

plugins.name: game-writer
plugins.description: Écriture de contenu narratif pour le jeu vidéo (projet 8-MINE) : bank d'assets narrative, écriture et revue de timelines Dialogic/Godot. La partie technique GDScript/moteur vit dans sc-godot. (ex-gamedesign)

plugins.name: sc-godot
plugins.description: Godot/GDScript ecosystem (squelette) : sniff, audit, improve, legacy, teach — partie technique du jeu vidéo, pendant de game-writer. Skills à porter (template sc-*).

plugins.name: sc-php
plugins.description: PHP ecosystem skills: sniff, audit, improve, legacy, teach, log-analysis (tail/parse-errors/search/summarize sur logs PHP/Apache/Nginx local, Docker ou SSH prod), bruno (tests API Bruno en CLI, itère jusqu'au vert). design-bridge: réceptacle du pivot design (enforce → linter PHP/WP natif + pre-commit ; diffuse → block pattern WP + theme.json) ; possède le workflow de plateforme FSE (design:detail), phase modèle de contenu comprise (CPT/taxonomies dérivés de la référence, templates de vue). builder-coverage: gate WYSIWYG FSE — couverture (chaque composant de page a une pattern éditable) + organisation (patterns rangées par rôle de section, sans fourre-tout). setup: scaffold-from-zero WordPress FSE/Laravel/Symfony + Docker Compose, garde-fou COMPOSE_PROJECT_NAME, pipeline de déploiement SSH optionnel (rsync + export DB conditionnel).

plugins.name: sc-js
plugins.description: JS knowledge provider: detects runtime (web/desktop), framework (Nuxt/Vue/SvelteKit/Alpine/Vite/Astro), ORMs and capabilities, then emits a pivot manifeste. /sc-js:audit delegates code review to aidd-dev:reviewer. improve, legacy (Vue 2→3, ESM, TS), teach (composables, reactivity, async). Perf pivots (SvelteKit), store pivots (Svelte stores), Biome pivot, data pivots for web-optimize and data-optimize. design-bridge: réceptacle du pivot design (enforce → règle ESLint/Biome + pre-commit ; diffuse → composant Vue 3 SFC ou React) ; possède le workflow de plateforme SPA (design:detail). wp-blocks: round-trip de validité des blocs Gutenberg (Playwright, éditeur) pour markup FSE généré hors éditeur.

plugins.name: sc-css
plugins.description: CSS ecosystem skills: sniff (architecture + stack), audit (spécificité, code mort, magic numbers, a11y), improve (custom properties, cascade layers, modernisation), legacy (float→flex/grid, px→rem, préfixes→standard), teach. design-bridge: réceptacle du pivot design — tokens.json → custom properties CSS, components.json → BEM stylesheets ; possède le workflow de plateforme statique (design:detail).

plugins.name: sc-tiers
plugins.description: Third-party SaaS consumption rules, installed into a project's .claude/rules/ by the setup skill: Firebase Firestore query limits, security rules, quota awareness, Auth listener cleanup, Hosting trailing slash and cache headers. Klaviyo API patterns: 2-step subscribe, 409→PATCH, lists, lazy loading. GTM Consent Mode v2: gtag() vs Array format, ensureGtag(), Meta Pixel consent, event taxonomy. Microsoft Clarity: best-effort model, consent-gated loading, queue init, dual push. PageSpeed Insights / Lighthouse: PSI variance, deterministic metrics, Nuxt 3 perf checklist (LCP/CLS/INP/TBT/bundle/cache).

plugins.name: sc-python
plugins.description: Python-specific skills and workflows: two-tier sniff (pivot model), audit (aidd-dev:reviewer), improve, legacy, log-analysis, teach (Django/FastAPI).

plugins.name: sc-rust
plugins.description: Rust-specific skills and workflows: two-tier sniff (pivot model), audit (aidd-dev:reviewer), improve, legacy, log-analysis, teach (Axum/Actix + SQLx/Diesel).

plugins.name: obs
plugins.description: Personal Obsidian notes management — project lifecycle, sessions, meetings, invoices, RAG export; email triage; the Documents/ organiser tree (cache-based: index, check, fix, sort, judge, destinations); filler skill (survey, sort, digest, index, merge, clean, condense, synthesize); research (documentary research and terminology extraction); extract-pdf (raw source ingestion).
